description: This file defines a React functional component 'GuardrailsPanel' which manages a list of guardrails, including fetching, adding, deleting, and viewing details. It also includes UI controls such as tabs, modals, and tables for interaction.

methods.name: fetchGuardrails
methods.description: Fetches the list of guardrails from the server and updates state.

methods.name: handleAddGuardrail
methods.description: Opens the modal to add a new guardrail.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes the guardrails list after successful addition.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Sets the guardrail to delete and opens the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Deletes the selected guardrail and updates the list.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Cancels the delete operation and closes the modal.
